The '''Tertiary Kesmere system''' was located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Cloud/Legends|cloudy]], storm-wracked [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tertiary Kesmere]].<ref name="Wizards" /> Between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Tertiary Kesmere [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated within the boundaries of the [[Pentastar Alignment]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tertiary Kesmere system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
